llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed mkts.io market-data integration with guarded account-management actions that require explicit user confirmation.

dimensions.detail: Network calls and optional API-key use are necessary for the market-data service, and the skill discloses what request data and private account records may be transmitted.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md with metadata requiring only curl and an optional MKTS_API_KEY environment variable; no install scripts or hidden execution paths were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions scope use to mkts.io endpoints, treat external content as untrusted, keep API keys private, minimize private data, and require exact target and payload review before mutations or deletions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Portfolio, journal, watchlist, registration, and portfolio-card features can create externally persisted data or a local PNG, but the artifact instructs agents to obtain explicit confirmation and avoid caching or sharing private responses.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides market data plus portfolio, journal, and watchlist workflows; account mutations are high-impact financial record changes but are directly aligned with the stated purpose and repeatedly gated by confirmation instructions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that read-only market data can be used without a key, but portfolio, journal, watchlist, registration, natural-language ask, and card-generation features may send sensitive financial information to mkts.io. Only approve mutations or deletions after reviewing the exact payload, target ID, and any no-undo warning.
